title: Regular bounded symmetric seed paths have a sharp completed-square quartic floor

regular_path.scope: X_q is a compact uniformly bounded family of symmetric centered unit-variance seeds with u_q=-kappa_4(X_q)->u_0>0, matched channel t_q=sqrt(q/u_q), kappa_6(X_q)/(u_q^(3/2)sqrt(q))->a and h_8(X_q)/u_q^2->x.
regular_path.uniformity: K1706's O_X(t^9) remainder is uniform on the compact bounded-support neighborhood used by the path, hence O(q^(9/2))=o(q^4).

scope_guard: The floor governs regular compact bounded symmetric weak-reward paths with u_0>0 and the stated scaled moment limits. It does not control growing support, vanishing negative defect, finite channel strength, correlated field laws or the unrestricted stationary coefficient.
